title: Canadian diabète risque évaluation Questionnaire (CANRISK)

how_to_use.why:
- L’identification des patients à risque peut permettre l’instauration rapide de stratégies préventives, telles que des tests de dépistage et des modifications du mode de vie.
- Cet outil ne nécessite pas d’analyses de laboratoire pour l’évaluation du risque, ce qui peut réduire les analyses sanguines inutiles et les coûts associés.
- Recommandé comme calculateur de risque validé par le Groupe d’étude canadien sur les soins de santé préventifs (CTFPHC).
how_to_use.when: Utilisé pour évaluer le risque de diabète de type 2 chez un patient lors des consultations de suivi médical de routine.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Modeled after the [Finnish Diabetes Risk Score (FINDRISC)](nabda:calc.findrisc-finnish-diabetes-risk-score) but includes additional factors, such as sex, ethnicity, history of macrosomia, and education level.
- Developed using a cohort of Canadian adults, limiting its applicability to non-Canadian populations.
- Relies on accurate self-reporting for some variables (e.g., physical activity, vegetable and fruit intake).
- Not intended as a diagnostic tool. Individuals identified as high- or very high-risk should undergo appropriate diagnostic testing.

next_steps.management:
Suggested management based on CTFPHC recommendations:

| Risk Level | Recommendation |
| --- | --- |
| Low to moderate | Routine screening for type 2 diabetes is not recommended. |
| High | Hemoglobin A1c screening every 3–5 years. |
| Very high | Hemoglobin A1c screening annually. |

For additional guidance on type 2 diabetes screening, please refer to the[Canadian Task Force on Preventive Health Care guidelines](https://canadiantaskforce.ca/the-canadian-task-force-on-preventive-health-care-releases-updated-guideline-for-screening-adults-for-type-2-diabetes/).

evidence:
Interprétation :

| Score CANRISK | Niveau de risque | Risque de diabète à 10 ans | Recommandation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0-32 | Faible à modéré | 1-17% | Le CTFPHC recommande de ne pas procéder à un dépistage systématique du diabète de type 2. |
| 33-42 | Élevé | 33% | Le CTFPHC recommande un dépistage tous les 3-5 ans avec l'A1c. |
| ≥43 | Très élevé | 50% | Le CTFPHC recommande un dépistage annuel avec l'A1c. |
more_info:
The CANRISK score is calculated by adding the selected points for each question. Please ask your patient the following questions:

| Question | Points | | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Age, years | 18-44 | 0 | |
| 45-54 | 7 | | |
| 55-64 | 13 | | |
| 65-74 | 15 | | |
| Gender | Female | 0 | |
| Male | 6 | | |
| BMI | <25 kg/m 2 | 0 | |
| 25-29 kg/m 2 | 4 | | |
| 30-34 kg/m 2 | 9 | | |
| ≥35 kg/m 2 | 14 | | |
| Waist circumference at the level of the belly button (measure after breathing out) | Men | <94 cm (<37 in) | 0 |
| 94-102 cm (37-40 in) | 4 | | |
| >102 cm (>40 in) | 6 | | |
| Women | <80 cm (<31.5 in) | 0 | |
| 80-88 cm (31.5-35 in) | 4 | | |
| >88 cm (>35 in) | 6 | | |
| Physical activity, such as brisk walking for at least 30 minutes each day | Yes | 0 | |
| No | 1 | | |
| How often do you eat vegetables or fruits? | Every day | 0 | |
| Not every day | 2 | | |
| History of high blood pressure OR prescription for high blood pressure | No or don’t know | 0 | |
| Yes | 4 | | |
| History of high blood sugar either from a blood test, during an illness, or during pregnancy | No or don’t know | 0 | |
| Yes | 14 | | |
| Given birth to a large baby weighing 9 pounds (4.1 kg) or more | No, don’t know, or not applicable | 0 | |
| Yes | 1 | | |
| Family history of diabetes (do not count multiple children or siblings twice) | No or don’t know | 0 | |
| One of the following: mother, father, brothers/sisters, children | 2 | | |
| Two of the following: mother, father, brothers/sisters, children | 4 | | |
| Three of the following: mother, father, brothers/sisters, children | 6 | | |
| All of the following: mother, father, brothers/sisters, children | 8 | | |
| Ethnic groups of biological (blood) parents (if more than one group applies, choose the one with the highest score) | White | 0 | |
| Aboriginal | 3 | | |
| Other non-white (Latin American, Arab, West Asian) | 3 | | |
| Black (Afro-Caribbean) | 5 | | |
| East Asian (Chinese, Vietnamese, Filipino, Korean, etc.) | 10 | | |
| South Asian (East Indian, Pakistani, Sri Lankan, etc.) | 11 | | |
| The highest level of education completed | University or college degree | 0 | |
| Some college or university | 0 | | |
| High school diploma | 1 | | |
| Some high school or less | 5 | | |
